name: Knowledge Vault
description: You have 200 bookmarks you'll never revisit and a 'Read Later' list that's basically a graveyard. Knowledge Vault changes the game: paste any URL — article, YouTube video, podcast, tweet thread, PDF — and OpenClaw instantly digests it, extracts the key takeaways, and stores everything in a searchable personal vault. The magic? OpenClaw actually learns the content. Ask it about a stat from a report you saved three months ago, and it pulls it up instantly.
